counterfactual_missing_items: No SARS-CoV-2 test result or imaging evidence of pneumonia
No schistocytes or ADAMTS13 testing to support TTP
No alternative explanation for thrombocytopenia and transaminitis
decisive_items: Tubular clot affixed to the distal ECMO drainage cannula (29F)
1 week of dyspnea, cough, chest pain
response.rationale: R2 is strongly supported by the presence of a tubular clot on the ECMO cannula, elevated D-dimer, and classic PE symptoms. R1 (COVID-19) is plausible given vaccination decline and respiratory symptoms but lacks confirmatory testing or imaging. R5 (TTP) is unlikely due to only mild thrombocytopenia and no other TTP features. C1 is a redundant completion of R1 and does not add diagnostic specificity.

rejected.why: Thrombocytopenia is mild (129) and no schistocytes, hemolysis, or neurologic/renal findings typical of TTP; the clot and D-dimer point to PE.
Append-only completion of R1 with no additional raw support; does not represent a distinct diagnosis and lacks evidence for severe COVID-19 pneumonia.
